scenes.title: Chess in the Lobby and Morning Guests
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov and Mikhail play chess in the lobby while Max's grandparents unexpectedly arrive at Vika's apartment.

scenes.title: A Surprise from Grandma and Grandpa
scenes.summary: Vika calls Max when his grandparents arrive for a heart checkup, and they agree to keep their separation a secret.

scenes.title: The New Cook Artyom
scenes.summary: After Artyom spills coffee on Eleonora, Chef Barinov hires him out of spite, and Eleonora demands a difficult test meal.

scenes.title: The Oversalted Gratin
scenes.summary: When Artyom ruins Eleonora's test dish, Chef Barinov secretly cooks the meal himself so Eleonora will not win their argument.

scenes.title: Checking In with Comfort
scenes.summary: Max settles his grandparents into a hotel room so they will not discover he no longer lives at Vika's apartment.

scenes.title: Medicine Drops or Vodka
scenes.summary: Vika warns Max about his grandfather's weak heart while the grandmother catches her husband sneaking vodka instead of medicine.

scenes.title: Eleonora's Secret Plot
scenes.summary: Artyom delivers the meal to Eleonora's suite, revealing they are secret lovers who tricked Barinov into hiring him.

scenes.title: Elena's Suspicion
scenes.summary: Elena learns how Viktor hired Artyom after a fight with Eleonora and suspects Eleonora tricked him into taking her candidate.

scenes.title: Grandma's Instructions
scenes.summary: Max's grandmother leaves to visit an old friend and charges Max with keeping his grandfather on a strict meat-free diet.

scenes.title: Grandpa's Order
scenes.summary: Max intercepts his grandfather's secret order of roast meat and strong liquor from Nastya.

scenes.title: Grandpa's Invented Diagnosis
scenes.summary: Max's grandfather tricks Max into giving him alcohol and meat by pretending the doctor gave him two months to live.

scenes.title: The Chef's Apology to Eleonora
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov tests Eleonora by offering to fire Artyom, and Eleonora offers him a bonus to keep the young cook.

scenes.title: Grandpa's Second Tall Tale
scenes.summary: Caught sneaking alcohol in a bag, Max's grandfather tells Vika that his wife is dying and has only two months to live.

scenes.title: Max's Advice for Lyova
scenes.summary: Max encourages a hesitant Lyova to act as if he had only one day left to live and win Gulya before Artyom steals her away.

scenes.title: Main Courses for Artyom
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov assigns Artyom to cook all the main courses for Eleonora's VIP dinner to expose his lack of skill.

scenes.title: Grandpa's Third Lie
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov presents Artyom to Eleonora's guests, while Max's grandfather tells his wife that Max and Vika are divorcing.

scenes.title: Take Your Hands Off Her
scenes.summary: After Eleonora's guests politely praise the food, an arrogant Artyom grabs Gulya in the kitchen and Lyova confronts him.

scenes.title: The Kitchen Brawl and Firing
scenes.summary: Lyova fights Artyom to defend Gulya, giving Chef Barinov the perfect excuse to fire Artyom in front of Eleonora.

scenes.title: Grandpa's Trick Is Exposed
scenes.summary: Vika and Max compare stories and realize Max's grandfather lied to both of them about dying in two months.

scenes.title: Remember to Live
scenes.summary: After a doctor treats Max's grandmother for an angina scare, Lyova buys flowers for Gulya as Max reflects on cherishing life.
